subject: Career
title: LinkedIn vs. Resume: Different Tools
description: A short lesson to help you apply LinkedIn vs. Resume: Different Tools.

hook.text: Your LinkedIn shouldn't be a copy-paste of your resume. They serve different purposes.

buildup.text: Resumes are tailored per role. LinkedIn is your permanent brand — broader and more personal.

discovery.text: LinkedIn rewards storytelling and personality. Resumes reward precision and brevity.

twist.text: Recruiters check both. Contradictions between them raise red flags.

climax.text: Keep dates and titles consistent. Let tone and depth differ by platform.

punchline.text: Same story, different stages. Keep them aligned.

quiz.question: How should LinkedIn and resume content differ?
options: LinkedIn is broader; resumes are tailored per role

details.summary: LinkedIn and resumes serve different purposes despite containing similar information. LinkedIn is a networking and discovery tool optimized for ongoing visibility, while resumes are application tools optimized for specific role targeting and ATS compatibility.
details.whyItMatters: Treating LinkedIn as an online resume wastes its networking potential. Treating your resume as a printed LinkedIn profile misses the targeting opportunity. Each platform demands a distinct strategy.
takeaways: LinkedIn should be broader and more personality-driven than your resume
Resumes should be precisely tailored to each specific job application
Use LinkedIn for discovery and networking, resumes for formal applications

faq.question: Should your LinkedIn profile and resume contain the same information?
faq.answer: There should be overlap in core facts, but LinkedIn should include more detail, a broader range of experience, endorsements, and a more conversational summary. Your resume should be a targeted subset optimized for a specific role. Discrepancies in facts will raise red flags.

faq.question: Which should you update first when changing jobs, LinkedIn or your resume?
faq.answer: Update your resume first to have a targeted application tool ready. Update LinkedIn strategically since a sudden flurry of updates signals to your current employer that you are job searching. Use LinkedIn's privacy settings to manage visibility of profile changes.
